ambiguities.text: The term 'non-empty storage' is used without specifying how to efficiently check for storage emptiness.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume non-empty storage means at least one storage slot has a non-zero value. Checking may require storage trie inspection.

ambiguities.text: The specification does not detail how 'revert as though the init code's first byte were an invalid opcode' interacts with gas refunds.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume standard revert semantics apply: remaining gas is refunded, but gas consumed up to the revert point is lost.

implicit_assumptions.description: Assumes only 28 addresses on mainnet have the vulnerable residual storage condition.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Additional vulnerable addresses could exist that are not accounted for, potentially allowing code injection attacks.

implicit_assumptions.description: Assumes implementations can efficiently check for non-empty storage without performance degradation.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Expensive storage checks could be exploited for DoS attacks by forcing clients to enumerate storage tries.

implicit_assumptions.description: Assumes EIP-7702 authority accounts increment nonces before this check, preventing conflicts.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: EIP-7702 delegated accounts could potentially be subject to unexpected creation failures.
